name: 天涯&碧血江湖
english_name: Bi Xue Jiang Hu — Tianya Edition
english_description: The Tianya MUD Wizard Group's "Bi Xue Jiang Hu" (Jianghu of Sworn Blood) archive, a long-running wuxia MUD that has operated since 2002. The archive compiled and booted cleanly under WASM with no fixes needed, but deeper functional testing turned up several real, previously unknown bugs, including a serious security flaw dating back to the game's founding. It belongs to the same "Tianya" codebase family as several other archives in this collection (including wlhd and xhcii), sharing near-identical core systems even where each site's map content was customized independently.
